kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتمد (form VIII)
# أَعْتَمِدُ (ʔaʕtamidu) /ʔaʕ.ta.mi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# أُعْتَمَدُ (ʔuʕtamadu) /ʔuʕ.ta.ma.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# أَعْتَمِدَ (ʔaʕtamida) /ʔaʕ.ta.mi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# أُعْتَمَدَ (ʔuʕtamada) /ʔuʕ.ta.ma
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
